power.method: 10,000mAh built-in rechargeable Li-ion battery, or hardwired via included adapter (100-240V 50/60Hz input, 5.0V/2.0A output) with jumper-enabled always-on mode

features: 2K QHD video doorbell with chime included

frigate.notes: RTSP only available when hardwired with Always-On mode enabled in Tapo app (Advanced Settings > Always-On). On battery power RTSP is disabled. Portrait aspect ratio — set detect to 720x960. go2rtc alternative: TP-Link's proprietary protocol via go2rtc (tapo://<tapo-account-password>@{ip}) is often more stable than RTSP (fewer timeouts / non-monotonic-timestamp errors). The password form is firmware-dependent: either your Tapo app/cloud account password, or user `admin` + the UPPERCASE SHA-256 of the camera password (`tapo://admin:<UPPERCASE-SHA256>@{ip}`) — see go2rtc's Tapo docs. It is not the camera's plain RTSP/Device password. If non-monotonic-timestamp errors persist, disable audio for that camera in Frigate. Chrome may render the go2rtc live view with a squashed aspect ratio (a browser live-view quirk, not the stream); Firefox is correct. The go2rtc tapo:// source also carries a two-way-audio backchannel, so Frigate's live view gets a talk button (mic+speaker).

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Doorbell press exposed as event. RTSP requires Always-On mode (hardwired only) — on battery, only cloud/app access works.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Requires Always-On mode (hardwired only).
